approved_payload.content: An 11-year-old girl was swept away by fast-flowing floodwater on the afternoon of Tuesday 17 November in Dobsonville, Soweto, during heavy rain and thunderstorms, shortly after her school transport dropped her off, the Mail & Guardian and IOL report. IOL places the drop-off in Snake Park, near Dobsonville Extension 3. Joburg EMS, the SAPS Water Wing and K9 Unit, police divers, private security, City Parks workers and residents searched the stream; her body was recovered on Friday 20 November not far from where she was last seen, the Mail & Guardian reports, and her family identified her. Gauteng CoGTA MEC Jacob Mamabolo was at the scene. The child is not named here. The map point is estimated: the Dobsonville suburb point, not the stream.
